title: Love it!
text: Love it!. Ok this is a great little gadget! (I am an adult with no children) and I love it! I already made my own “Uncrustables”! The seller also sent a great little PDF recipe book! Three different sets/ shapes come in the order and They are so easy to use and clean.! Super happy!

product_metadata.title: Savoychef Sandwich Cutter and Sealer - Uncrustables Sandwich Maker - Cut and Seal - Great for Lunchbox and Bento Box - Boys and Girls Kids Lunch - Circle, Square, Triangles
features: 🍞 FOR LARGE-SIZED BREAD ONLY: Our sandwich sealers are designed to accommodate bread sizes of 4x4 or larger. Please note that we do not recommend using gluten-free bread, and we strongly advise measuring your bread before making a purchase to ensure it is the correct size. Recommended brands are the following: Martin's, Nature’s Own, Sara Lee, Dave's Killer Bread, Pepperidge Farm, Wonderbread, King’s Hawaiian and more.

👶 PATENTED DESIGN: Tired of buying pre-made sandwiches from your grocery store? Use our patented cutter and sealer combo to create your own! The size is 3.5x3.5" so it's suitable for larger sized bread.

❤️ OVER 10,000 PARENTS SATISFIED: Enjoy spending time in the kitchen with your children by making fun lunches together! 10,000+ parents and children across the world have chosen Savoychef products. Order now to join the family!

😎 COOLEST KID IN SCHOOL: Our set makes it easy to turn a boring lunch into fun shapes in a jiffy before school. Suitable for both girls and boys, they will love the healthy tidbits in their lunchboxes so much that they'll want to show them off to their friends.
🏆SAFE AND HIGH QUALITY: The Savoychef's sandwich cutter set is safe and 100% free from BPA, lead, PVC, mercury, and phthalates. Also, top-rack dishwasher safe!

🤗 100% SATISFACTION: We are a small family business and our goal is to provide products that people love. If for any reason you're not satisfied with your purchase, please contact us and we'll do everything in our power to make things right!
